name: Nad Al Sheba Gardens Phase 2 By Meraas
paymentPlan: 10% down payment at sales launch, 40% during construction, and 50% on handover
overview: Nad Al Sheba Gardens Phase 2 is Meraas Holding's new, luxurious residential development in the heart of Nad Al Sheba, Dubai. This exclusive project offers a mix of three, four, and five-bedroom townhouses and villas, all designed with a nostalgic philosophy that combines modern amenities with classic elegance. This under-construction project, which is expected to be completed in Q4 2024, promises a distinguished lifestyle within a private gated community.
